name: Banyan Tree Vabbinfaru
positioning: Island resort in North Malé Atoll, founded in 1995, where every villa is a beach villa with a private pool and a house reef circles the island
best_for: Snorkellers and divers who want a house reef steps from the shore
Travellers interested in coral restoration and marine conservation
Guests focused on spa and wellbeing

facts.text: The resort is in North Malé Atoll, 25 minutes by speedboat from Velana International Airport.
The island is encircled by a house reef just steps from the shore.
Guests can step from the beach into the water, where coral gardens and marine life begin just moments from shore.
A PADI dive centre offers dives on the house reef, the nearby Rannamaari shipwreck and surrounding dive sites, plus PADI courses.
Other water activities include kayaking, stand-up paddleboarding, catamaran sailing, windsurfing, jet skiing and dolphin cruises.
The Beachfront Sunset View Pool Villa has a private pool, jet pool, direct ocean access and sunset views over the Indian Ocean.
The Wellbeing Sanctuary Pool Villa has sleep-focused design, sustainable Maldivian interiors, a private pool and direct beach access.
The Oceanview Pool Villa is set back in its own secluded garden, with Indian Ocean views from the pool deck.
Resident Wellbeing Practitioner Dr. Sharma has a background in Naturopathy and a specialisation in Clinical Acupuncture.
Wellbeing experiences include private yoga, breathwork, Lagoon Floating Therapy and sound baths.
Madi Hiyaa is an overwater Japanese restaurant built entirely from bamboo.
Dining runs across four venues linked by a dine-around concept, including Thai cuisine at Saffron and the beachfront Naiboli Bar.

highlights.text: The resort's Marine Lab, established in 2004, is one of the Maldives' first resort-based marine conservation centres, working on coral restoration, reef monitoring and marine education.
Banyan Tree Spa here was the first international spa in the Maldives, with therapists trained for over 600 hours at the Banyan Tree Spa & Wellbeing Academy.
Every villa is a beach villa with its own private pool.
In the Beachfront Pool Villa the private pool sits at the main door and the beach opens out at the backyard.
Founded in 1995, Banyan Tree Vabbinfaru is one of the pioneers of luxury hospitality in the Maldives.

considerations.text: All destination dining experiences are subject to weather conditions and seasonality.
The island can be exclusively reserved for private celebrations and special occasions.
